name: block-empty-state
summary: Empty, no-results, error, and no-access state panels with recovery actions.
description: A Web block for the moments a page has nothing to show: empty collections, empty search results, failed loads (announced as an alert, with an optional request id), and missing access. Each variant has its own decorative icon and tone; title, description, and actions arrive through props, and a bare mode fits inside cards and table cells. Built from theme tokens and lucide-react icons; it fetches nothing.
use_when: a list, table, or search can be empty and should guide the user to a next step
a page needs a consistent error or no-access panel with a retry action
the builder asks for empty, error, or permission states
